{{Short description|Vanishing theorem for multiplier ideals}}

In mathematics, the '''Nadel vanishing theorem''' is a global [[vanishing theorem]] for [[multiplier ideal]]s, introduced by A. M. Nadel in 1989.<ref>{{harv|Nadel|1990}}</ref> It generalizes the [[Kodaira vanishing theorem]] using singular metrics with (strictly) positive curvature, and also it can be seen as an analytical analogue of the [[Kawamata–Viehweg vanishing theorem]].

== Statement ==
The theorem can be stated as follows.<ref>{{harv|Lazarsfeld|2004|loc=Theorem 9.4.8.}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Demailly|Ein|Lazarsfeld|2000}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Fujino|2011|loc=Theorem 3.2}}</ref> Let X be a smooth [[complex projective variety]], D an effective <math>\mathbb{Q}</math>-[[divisor (algebraic geometry)#Q-divisors|divisor]] and L a [[line bundle]] on X, and <math>\mathcal{J}(D)</math> is a multiplier ideal sheaves. Assume that <math>L - D</math> is [[big line bundle|big]] and [[Nef line bundle|nef]]. Then

<math>H^{i} \left(X, \mathcal{O}_{X}(K_X + L) \otimes \mathcal{J}(D) \right) = 0 \;\; \text{for} \;\; i > 0.</math>

Nadel vanishing theorem in the analytic setting:<ref>{{harv|Lazarsfeld|2004|loc=Theorem 9.4.21.}}</ref><ref>{{harv|Demailly|1998–1999}}</ref> Let <math>(X, \omega)</math> be a [[Kähler manifold]] (X be a reduced complex space ([[complex analytic variety]]) with a Kähler metric) such that weakly [[pseudoconvex]], and let F be a [[holomorphic line bundle]] over X equipped with a singular [[hermitian metric]] of weight <math>\varphi</math>. Assume that <math>\sqrt{-1} \cdot \theta(F) > \varepsilon \cdot \omega</math> for some continuous positive function <math>\varepsilon</math> on X. Then

<math>H^{i} \left(X, \mathcal{O}_{X}(K_X + F) \otimes \mathcal{J}(\varphi) \right) = 0 \;\; \text{for} \;\; i > 0.</math>

Let arbitrary [[plurisubharmonic function]] <math>\phi</math> on <math>\Omega \subset X</math>, then a multiplier ideal sheaf <math>\mathcal{J}(\phi)</math> is a coherent on <math>\Omega</math>, and therefore its zero variety is an analytic set.
